SEC:175:2026-27/MAA 
September 11, 2026 
 
The Manager - Listing  
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Capital Market – Listing 
Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor 
Plot No. C/1, G Block 
Bandra-Kurla Complex 
 
 
Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051 
 
Dear Sir, 
 
Re: 
Disclosure under Reg. 30 read with Sch. III. Part A. Para A of SEBI (LODR) 
Regulations, 2015 – Participation in Institutional Investors’ Meeting  
 
We wish to inform you that today from 2.15 P.M to 3.15 P.M., Mr. Rajiv C. Lochan, Managing Di-
rector and Mr. M. Ramaswamy, Chief Financial Officer had an interaction with UTI Pension Fund, 
Institutional Investor, regarding the overall performance of the Company. It was a one-to-one 
meet vide video conference. 
 
Further, we hereby confirm that:  
 
1. The interaction was primarily in the Q&A format. 
2. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared during the interaction.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
For Sundaram Finance Limited 
 
 
 
P.N. Srikant 
CCO & Company Secretary 
 
 
 
 
 
P N 
SRIKANT
Digitally signed 
by P N SRIKANT
